senses.gloss:
__1 A ram. 
__2 An elephant-driver or keeper.

मेठिः,
 
-मेढी, -मेथिः 
__1 A pillar, post. 
__2 A pillar in the midst of a threshing-floor to which oxen are bound. 
__3 A post to which cattle are bound; मेढ्यां गोचक्रवत्स्थास्नु परस्तात् कल्पवासिनाम् [[Bhāg. 4. 9. 21.]] 
__4 A prop for supporting the shafts of a carriage.
